arxiv-2310-07404.title: Integral Periodic Orbits on Affine Spaces
arxiv-2310-07404.creator: Minchan Kang
arxiv-2310-07404.description: Abstract . In this paper, we give an elementary proof on the existence of an effective uniform upper bound on the size of integral periodic orbits of a single endomorphism in an affine space, dependent solely on its dimension. In fact, we derive a formula relating the primitive period to the local primitive period obtained through reduction modulo prime number.

arxiv-2404-01169.title: A Comparative Study of Dust Grain Polarisation Efficiencies in the Interstellar and Intracluster Mediums towards Anti-Center Galaxy
arxiv-2404-01169.creator: N. Bijas, Chakali Eswaraiah, Panigrahy Sandhyarani, Jessy Jose, Maheswar Gopinathan
arxiv-2404-01169.description: Abstract Dust polarisation observations at optical wavelengths help understand the dust grain properties and trace the plane-of-the-sky component of the magnetic field. In this study, we make use of published optical polarisation data acquired with AIMPOL along with distances ( d d ) and extinction ( A V A_{\mathrm{V}} ) data.

arxiv-2409-16007.title: Normalized topological indices discriminate between architectures of branched macromolecules
arxiv-2409-16007.creator: Domen Vaupotič, Jules Morand, Luca Tubiana, Anže Božič
arxiv-2409-16007.description: Abstract Branching architecture characterizes numerous systems, ranging from synthetic (hyper)branched polymers and biomolecules such as lignin, amylopectin, and nucleic acids to tracheal and neuronal networks. Its ubiquity reflects the many favourable properties that arise because of it. For instance, branched macromolecules are spatially compact and have a high surface functionality, which impacts their phase characteristics and self-assembly behaviour, among others.

arxiv-2505-08607.title: Boosting Zero-shot Stereo Matching using Large-scale Mixed Images Sources in the Real World
arxiv-2505-08607.creator: Yuran Wang, Yingping Liang *, Ying Fu
arxiv-2505-08607.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuran Wang, Yingping Liang *, Ying Fu. Stereo matching methods rely on dense pixel-wise ground truth labels, which are laborious to obtain, especially for real-world datasets. The scarcity of labeled data and domain gaps between synthetic and real-world images also pose notable challenges. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, BooSTer , that leverages both vision foundation models and large-scale mixed image sources, including synthetic, real, and single-view images.

pmc-10570980.title: Clinical classification of recurrent laryngeal nerve palsy
pmc-10570980.creator: Chisato Tomoda, Kana Yoshioka, Yoshiyuki Saito, Chie Masaki, Junko Akaishi, Kiyomi Yamada Hames, Ritsuko Okamura, Akifumi Suzuki, Kenichi Matsuzu, Wataru Kitagawa, Kiminori Sugino, Koichi Ito
pmc-10570980.description: BackgroundThe application of intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM) has been accepted to avoid injury of a recurrent laryngeal nerve (RLN). Loss of the neuromonitoring signal indicates nerve injury and is subdivided into segmental type and global type nerve paralysis. This study aimed to determine the course of vocal cord function recovery after definitive loss of signal (LOS) types.

pmc-10613234.title: A super liquid-repellent hierarchical porous membrane for enhanced membrane distillation
pmc-10613234.creator: Youmin Hou, Prexa Shah, Vassilios Constantoudis, Evangelos Gogolides, Michael Kappl, Hans-Jürgen Butt
pmc-10613234.description: Membrane distillation (MD) is an emerging desalination technology that exploits phase change to separate water vapor from saline based on low-grade energy. As MD membranes come into contact with saline for days or weeks during desalination, membrane pores have to be sufficiently small (typically <0.2 µm) to avoid saline wetting into the membrane.

pmc-11396833.title: Producing Freestanding Single-Crystal BaTiO3 Films through Full-Solution Deposition
pmc-11396833.creator: Guoqiang Xi, Hangren Li, Dongfei Lu, Xudong Liu, Xiuqiao Liu, Jie Tu, Qianqian Yang, Jianjun Tian, Linxing Zhang
pmc-11396833.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Strontium aluminate, with suitable lattice parameters and environmentally friendly water solubility, has been strongly sought for use as a sacrificial layer in the preparation of freestanding perovskite oxide thin films in recent years. However, due to this material’s inherent water solubility, the methods used for the preparation of epitaxial films have mainly been limited to high-vacuum techniques, which greatly limits these films’ development.

pmc-11425669.title: 218 Understanding Recruitment into Structured Exercise Classes for Individuals with Chronic Conditions
pmc-11425669.creator: Tadhg Pyne, Andrew O’Regan, Clodagh Toomey, Catherine Woods
pmc-11425669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). As populations are ageing, the prevalence of chronic health conditions is rising and while physical activity is an established treatment for chronic conditions, involving people in community-based classes is challenging. The aim of this project is to understand challenges associated with recruiting individuals with chronic diseases into community-based structured exercise classes purposefully designed for the management of their condition in the Midwest of Ireland. ULMedX is one such class.MethodsA focus group with individuals who had attended ULMedx or equivalent was undertaken.

pmc-11426138.title: Phytic acid-loaded polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel promotes wound healing of injured corneal epithelium through inhibiting ferroptosis
pmc-11426138.creator: Danni Gong, Nianxuan Wu, Huan Chen, Weijie Zhang, Chenxi Yan, Chunlei Zhang, Yao Fu, Hao Sun
pmc-11426138.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). As the important barrier of intraocular tissue, cornea is easy to suffer various kinds of injuries. Among them, acute alkali burn is a thorny ophthalmic emergency event, which can lead to corneal persistent epithelial defects, ulcers, and even perforation. Ferroptosis, a mode of regulatory cell death, has been found to play a key role in the process of corneal alkali burn, of which lipid peroxidation and intracellular iron levels are considered to be the possible therapeutic targets.

pmc-12644777.title: A lightweight LSTM-based open-set RF fingerprinting identification for edge deployment
pmc-12644777.creator: Yuxuan Hu, Yutong Fu, Ye Chen
pmc-12644777.description: With the rapid advancement of deep learning techniques, numerous neural networks have been successfully developed for radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting identification. In this work, we propose a lightweight yet reliable neural network framework featuring a 9-layer architecture based on the long short-term memory (LSTM) strategy, designed for efficient open-set fingerprinting identification.

pmc-12730184.title: Reduced Fibrinolysis Links Obesity to Cardiovascular Risk in Psoriasis Independently of Inflammation: A Novel Mechanistic Pathway
pmc-12730184.creator: Eva Klara MERZEL ŠABOVIC, Tadeja KRANER ŠUMENJAK, Miodrag JANIĆ
pmc-12730184.description: as a risk-enhancing condition (2), particularly in patients with concomitant obesity (3). Obesity itself promotes a pro-inflammatory and pro-thrombotic state through adipose tissue-derived mediators, including plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 (PAI-1), which suppresses fibrinolysis (4). While the links between systemic inflammation, endothelial dysfunction, and atherosclerosis in psoriasis have been extensively studied (5), the role of impaired fibrinolytic activity remains largely underexplored.
